acceptance: Contract separates proposal, simulation, acceptance, verification, and activation as distinct states.
title: Define graph-mutation lifecycle through activation

acceptance: Contract defines legal supersession/rollback transitions and preserves predecessor identity.
title: Define supersession and rollback mutation transitions

acceptance: Proposal ID changes on content change and proposal bytes cannot mutate after simulation begins.
title: Make graph-mutation proposals immutable and content-addressed

acceptance: Two rivals run from the same root hash and neither modifies canonical state during simulation.
title: Simulate mutations against an immutable current graph root

acceptance: Schema/invariant violation rejects proposal before any canonical write.
title: Add pre-promotion schema and invariant gate

acceptance: Policy raises evidence requirements for irreversible/high-blast-radius mutations without hidden scalar overrides.
title: Define evidence threshold policy from reversibility and blast radius

acceptance: Rejected proposals remain content-addressed trace evidence and cannot masquerade as active state.
title: Persist rejected mutation traces and reasons

acceptance: Adversarial mutation of verifier/promotion gate is rejected and gate hash remains unchanged.
title: Verify graph-edit generator cannot modify promotion authority

acceptance: Diff reports nodes added/removed/refined, edges changed, requirements affected, and residuals opened/closed.
title: Add semantic mutation diff

acceptance: Destructive proposal without an executable or evidenced rollback witness cannot promote.
title: Require rollback witness for destructive canonical mutations
